Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.

headline.value: Due to continuous increase of water level of River Dikhow at Sivasagar in Sivasagar district of Assam , Citizens are advised to stay away from the river. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.
headline.source: NDMA SACHET Common Alerting Protocol public feed (sachet.ndma.gov.in, feed marked public domain); alert content authored by the issuing agency (e.g. ASDMA, CWC, IMD)

description.value: River Dikhow at Shivsagar in Shivsagar district of Assam continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 11:00 pm today. At 11:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 91.4 m with rising trend which is 0.00 m above its Warning Level of 91.4 m and 1.00 m below its Danger Level of 92.4 m.
